name: github-tracking
description: Keeps a repo's GitHub issues, milestones and Projects board true while Claude works. Its track skill says which work gets an issue, how to write one and how the board works, and a script moves issues and PRs on it, makes sub-issues and posts status updates, so no CLAUDE.md keeps a project's ids. /github-tracking:track show says where the board stands and /github-tracking:track file files an issue. /github-tracking:init sets up the board and its views, and /github-tracking:migrate moves a repo's corkboard items onto it.
